zlib 1.3.2, the DEFLATE compressor RFC 8054 section 4 names (deflate.c, trees.c).

Upstream:  https://zlib.net/ (https://github.com/madler/zlib)
Release:   1.3.2 (2026-02-17)
Tarball:   https://zlib.net/zlib-1.3.2.tar.gz
           SHA-256 bb329a0a2cd0274d05519d61c667c062e06990d72e125ee2dfa8de64f0119d16
           (the same digest Homebrew's zlib 1.3.2 formula pins)
Copied:    LICENSE, adler32.c, crc32.c, crc32.h, deflate.c, deflate.h, trees.c,
           trees.h, zutil.c, zutil.h, zlib.h, zconf.h -> this directory
           (unmodified)
Licence:   LICENSE (the zlib licence) for everything copied.
Not copied: the inflater (inflate.c, inftrees.c, inffast.c, infback.c), the
           gzip file layer, compress/uncompress, the programs.  fn never
           decompresses in C: a client's COMPRESS DEFLATE stream is decoded by
           ACL2 (books/deflate-inflate.lisp fn-zin-feed).

Role: the OUTBOUND compressor of an NNTP COMPRESS DEFLATE session only
(host/native/fn-deflate.c, host/native/deflate.lisp).  It compresses octets
ACL2 already decided (the rendered reply windows) with a sync flush after
each; a fault here can garble only what the server sends, never what it reads
or stores.  libdeflate is not used: its streams always end with a final block,
and an RFC 8054 stream never ends.

Refresh: fetch the release tarball, check its SHA-256 against the published
digest (Homebrew's formula pins it), re-copy the same files, update the lines
above and the digests below, rebuild (tools/build_deflate.sh) and rerun
tests/test_deflate_library.py.
